question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Expiation
solution:
The correct answer is "**Atonement**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **"Expiation" means making amends for a wrongdoing or sin.**(परिशुद्धि)

 
 
• Example: He went on a pilgrimage as an act of expiation for his past sins.
 
 
 
• ​**"Atonement" also means the same thing, i.e., making up for a mistake or a sin.**(प्रायश्चित करना)
 
• Atonement can also mean reconciliation between two parties or the act of making up for a mistake or a wrong decision.
 
 
• Example: Most of us felt that they were on a mission of atonement.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, it is clear that the word "atonement" is the synonym of the word "expiation."

Hence,** the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 (Expediency) means the quality of being convenient or practical, regardless of what is morally right or wrong.(मुनाफ़ा)
 
• Option 3 (Transformation) means a thorough or dramatic change in form or appearance.(परिवर्तन)
 
• Option 4 (Explanation) means a statement or account that makes something clear.(स्पष्टीकरण)
